title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a paper-clip experiment sheet with a results table
body:
## Problem
The paper clip is the hook of Session 1 but there is no printable sheet for the experiment.

## Context
Students learn most from counting bends to failure themselves and comparing the spread of their results.

## Expected outcome
A one-page activity sheet with a results table (clip number, bend angle, bends to failure) and three questions about scatter.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sheet added and linked from the Session 1 README
- [ ] Safety note about small metal pieces and eye protection

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add the fatigue notch factor K_f (Peterson) to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Session 2 applies the full K_t to the fatigue life, which is conservative.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, milestone 1. A notch sensitivity function gives K_f between 1 and K_t.

## Expected outcome
A `fatigue_notch_factor(kt, radius, ...)` function, a test and a short explanation.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] K_f tends to 1 as the notch radius tends to 0 and to K_t for large radii
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a reliability design life function to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 shows the scatter of fatigue life but does not turn it into a design life.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3.

## Expected outcome
A function that returns the life reached by a chosen fraction of parts, with a Monte Carlo check.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Analytic and Monte Carlo values agree within 5 percent
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: S-N point, growing crack and damage bars
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows initiation and propagation on one clock; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation and an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The damage bar reaches 1.0 when the crack appears
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
